name: bell_tresillo
description: Double bell in the three-three-two pattern.
character: A pair of metal bells struck in the three-three-two pattern: a bright, short accent that tells the ear where the pulse leans and keeps the interlock clear.
sources: KB african (the bell pattern of three-three-two keeps the cycle together)
ESTIMATE: level and placement are starting values

MEASURED: a leave-one-out on the summed stems cut the click events from 85 to 27 without the koto and to 33 without the shaker; STARTING VALUE: low-pass at 6.5 kHz because a phone speaker returns little above 5-6 kHz and the sweeps fire a pluck every 25-60 ms
STARTING VALUE: onset_fade_ms 10: several strokes land together on every strong beat and their sharp starts add into one impulse the click row flags; a soft attack is also what "smooth" asks for

STARTING VALUE: low-pass at 4.5 kHz: a phone speaker returns little above about 5 kHz (KB short-form-functional-music), and the sharp edges of plucked and struck onsets above it are what the click row reacts to

CARRIED OVER from the ringtone project 'Confluence', where each filter, fade and level in this preset was set by a measurement (click count, stem.dropout, equal_loudness); not re-measured for the alarm until the gate runs
